name: Italian Dressing
siboNotes: Most commercial Italian dressings are low FODMAP in typical serving sizes. Check labels for high FODMAP ingredients like garlic or onion powder.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for garlic and onion - some brands use these
Make homemade with olive oil, vinegar, oregano, and basil for guaranteed low FODMAP option
Store opened bottles in refrigerator and shake before use
Start with smaller amounts if you have severe SIBO symptoms
nutritionalHighlights: Provides healthy fats from olive oil
Contains antioxidants from herbs and spices
